name: Exterior Foundation RP Surface Preparation
intent: RP prep — efflorescence treatment, pressure wash, scrape/feather, crack patch, dust cleanup.
doctrine: RP foundation prep. Condition modifier on scrape/feather (GOOD:1.0, FAIR:1.3, POOR:1.6 — foundation-specific scale). Pressure wash at 1500-2500 PSI (valid on masonry). No form-release removal (NC only). Foundation type modifier (CMU=1.15x) on wash.
